description: Photo colorize preset library — LLM + OpenCV pipeline

DAYLIGHT.name: Natural/Outdoor Day
DAYLIGHT.condition: Siang hari di luar ruangan, pencahayaan alami merata

OVERCAST.name: Overcast/Mendung
OVERCAST.condition: Langit mendung, cahaya flat, tidak ada bayangan keras

params.x: Flat overcast, warm and contrast boost

LOWLIGHT.name: Low-Light Indoor
LOWLIGHT.condition: Dalam ruangan cahaya redup, lampu incandescent/tungsten
LOWLIGHT.notes: b dan d harus diangkat bersama. c harus >= 1.0 untuk mencegah flat.

params.x: Low light indoor, lift shadows, correct tungsten

BACKLIGHT.name: Backlight/Contre-Jour
BACKLIGHT.condition: Sumber cahaya di belakang subjek, background terang
BACKLIGHT.notes: JANGAN flatten contrast. c harus 0.90-1.05. d >= +25. h <= -25.

GOLDEN_HR.name: Golden Hour
GOLDEN_HR.notes: Pertahankan warmth — ini intended look. s sedikit turun agar skin tidak oranye.

params.x: Golden hour, preserve warmth, recover highlights

HIGH_KEY.name: High-Key Studio
HIGH_KEY.condition: Studio dengan lighting terang merata, background putih/abu

params.x: High-key studio, highlight recovery, maintain contrast

BLUE_SKY_SPILL.name: Blue Sky Color Spill
BLUE_SKY_SPILL.condition: Outdoor langit biru cerah, bayangan terasa kebiruan

params.x: Blue sky spill, warm shadows, neutral skin

GREEN_SPILL.name: Green Wall/Ceiling Spill
GREEN_SPILL.condition: Dinding/plafon hijau memantul ke skin dan subjek
GREEN_SPILL.notes: JANGAN over-correct. t hanya cancel spill, bukan shift entire image. Cek skin tone setelah koreksi.

params.x: Green wall spill, magenta tint correction, skin safe

GREEN_CAST.name: LED/Fluorescent Green Cast
GREEN_CAST.notes: Berbeda dari GREEN_SPILL: seluruh gambar affected. t negatif (ke hijau di tint scale = counter hijau).

params.x: LED green cast, global tint and warmth correction

NEON.name: Neon/Mixed Artificial Light
NEON.condition: Lingkungan neon, multiple color source, bar/club/event
NEON.notes: Jangan coba koreksi ke neutral. Pertahankan mood. k:-15 untuk deep blacks.

params.x: Mixed neon light, mood preserve, contrast boost

SKIN_WARM.name: Skin Oversaturated/Orange
SKIN_WARM.condition: Kulit terlalu oranye atau merah, tidak natural
SKIN_WARM.notes: Skin tone limits: v <= 1.3, s <= 1.2 (wajib dipatuhi di semua kondisi).

params.x: Skin oversaturated, reduce sat and warmth

SKIN_PALE.name: Skin Pale/Cold
SKIN_PALE.condition: Kulit terlihat pucat, kebiruan, atau abu-abu

params.x: Pale skin, boost warmth and vibrance gently

PORTRAIT.name: Portrait Skin Soften
PORTRAIT.condition: Portrait wajah close-up, ingin skin halus dan flattering
PORTRAIT.notes: l negatif adalah fitur utama. l < -15 mulai terlihat buatan.

params.x: Portrait soft skin, negative clarity, vibrance boost

WINDOW_LIGHT.name: Indoor Window Light
WINDOW_LIGHT.condition: Cahaya dari jendela satu arah, bayangan satu sisi

params.x: Window light, lift directional shadows, warm slightly

NIGHT.name: Malam/Night Photography
NIGHT.condition: Foto malam outdoor, campuran sumber cahaya artifisial
NIGHT.notes: d jangan lebih +30 jika ada langit hitam pekat. p rendah untuk menekan noise.

params.x: Night photo, preserve mood, careful shadow lift

HAZE.name: Hazy/Foggy Outdoor
HAZE.condition: Kabut atau haze di outdoor, warna flat dan pucat
HAZE.notes: k negatif agresif untuk mengembalikan blacks yang terangkat oleh haze.

params.x: Haze/fog, deep blacks, contrast and saturation boost
